title: How would you estimate how many ride-hailing trips are taken in London each day?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "How many ride-hailing trips are taken in London each day?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: Daily trips depend on a small share of people, so the share you choose drives the whole answer. Defend it carefully. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

How many ride-hailing trips are taken in London each day?

The approach

People × share taking a trip today × trips each.

Tip: Name the assumption that matters most, so the interviewer knows where the estimate is most sensitive.

Step by step

  1. People in London: 9M
  2. × 3% take a ride-hailing trip on a given day
  3. × 1.5 trips each (often there and back)

That gives about 405k trips a day.

Does it make sense?

Visitors and commuters from outside London would add to this.
